user.title: Connect to AutoDomo
user.description: In the AutoDomo app open your home, tap **Bridges → Add Home Assistant** and type the code shown there. It is valid for 10 minutes and works once.

advanced.name: Advanced (development)
advanced.description: Leave as is. Only change to point to your own Firebase project or the emulator.

entities.title: What the app can see and control
entities.description: Lights, switches, covers, climate, locks and fans are preselected. Sensors are left out by default — add only the ones that make sense in the app. You can change this later in *Configure*.

data.auto_add: Automatically expose new lights, switches, covers, climate, locks and fans

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to AutoDomo
reauth_confirm.description: Bridge **{title}** lost access (revoked in the app or token expired). Generate a new code in **Bridges → Add Home Assistant** for the same home and type it here.

error.invalid_code: Invalid or already used code. Generate a new one in the app.
error.expired_code: Code expired. Generate a new one in the app.
error.wrong_home: This code belongs to another home. Generate it in the same home as this bridge.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach AutoDomo. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.reauth_successful: Reconnected. The bridge was recreated and devices republished.

init.title: What the app can see and control
init.description: Select the entities the AutoDomo app should show. Only supported domains are listed.

data.auto_add: Automatically expose new lights, switches, covers, climate, locks and fans

missing_entity.title: Entity exposed to AutoDomo no longer exists
missing_entity.description: Entity `{entity_id}` is selected for the AutoDomo app but no longer exists in Home Assistant. Open **Configure** on the AutoDomo integration and unselect it.
